slide_title: Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of ONE Vector by a Matrix
subtitle_or_header: Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word X by W_q (Query) {Remember: W_q is Squared Matrix}

bullets: Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word X by W_q (Query) {Remember: W_q is Squared Matrix}
labels: Input Word X (left panel header; 'Input Word' black, 'X' red)
Σ (summation symbol inside each of the 4 neurons, left panel)
Y^T (top-middle panel, red, T is superscript)
IF No Non-linearity (black callout, rendered on two lines: 'IF No' / 'Non-linearity')
Y^T (bottom-middle panel, red, T is superscript)
X (top-right panel, red, label under the x-circle row)
+ (plus sign between curly brace and bias column, both right panels)
X (bottom-right panel, red, label under the x-circle row)
IF No Bias (black callout between the two right panels)
} (large blue right-curly brace right of each matrix, both right panels)
equations: Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Sigmoid   (top-middle panel: red 'Y^T' + row of four yellow boxes y1..y4 + blue '= Sigmoid')
Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Linear   (bottom-middle panel: red 'Y^T' + row of four yellow boxes y1..y4 + blue '= Linear')
Y = W_q · X + b   [implied by the diagram (X vector × W_q matrix, then + bias column); not explicitly written as text on the slide]

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with a yellow slide-number badge '10' at the top-right corner; a one-line subtitle spans the width beneath the title. Below, three vertical zones: LEFT panel (~5-28% width) is a white blue-bordered rounded box containing a 4-input to 4-neuron fully-connected network labeled 'Input Word X'; CENTER column (~30-53% width) holds two stacked gray rounded panels (top: 'Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Sigmoid', bottom: 'Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Linear') with a black 'IF No Non-linearity' callout straddling the gap between them and a thick red arrow running down through it; RIGHT zone (~54-94% width) holds two stacked panels, each showing a horizontal X vector of pink circles, a 4x4 W_q matrix (yellow cells on green), a blue curly brace, a '+' sign and a vertical bias column (b1..b4 in the top panel; 0,0,0,0 in the bottom panel), with a black 'IF No Bias' callout and red down-arrow between the two panels at the far right. A solid black bar runs across the very bottom edge of the frame.

layout.hierarchy: The red bold title dominates, followed by the blue bold-italic subtitle. Inside the panels, the largest items are the red 'Y^T' labels and red 'X' labels. The black callout boxes ('IF No Non-linearity', 'IF No Bias') are small but maximum-contrast focal points, reinforced by thick red arrows. Matrix cells, bias boxes and node labels are mid-size bold; the 16 weight labels in the left panel are the smallest text. A consistent color code (blue/magenta/orange/green) links the left-panel weight labels to the corresponding matrix rows.

visual_elements.description: Fully-connected feedforward network, 4 inputs to 4 outputs, inside the left panel. Inputs: four pink circles (fill #FF9CEE, border #CC00CC) labeled x1, x2, x3, x4 stacked vertically. Outputs: four circles (white fill, red #CC0000 border) each containing 'Σ', aligned with the inputs. All 16 input-to-neuron connections drawn as thin gray lines. A vertical column of 16 weight labels sits between inputs and neurons, color-coded by source input: W_11, W_21, W_31, W_41 (blue, from x1); W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 (magenta, from x2); W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 (orange, from x3); W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (green, from x4). Each Σ neuron has a small multicolored pie/wheel icon at its upper-left and a gray halftone (dotted) circle beneath it, and emits a short green arrow to a green bold label y1/y2/y3/y4.

Two identical output-vector rows (one per middle panel): red bold 'Y^T' (superscript T) followed by a horizontal group of four small pale-yellow boxes labeled y1, y2, y3, y4 (black bold text), the group wrapped in a pink/magenta rounded-rectangle outline; to the right, '= Sigmoid' (top panel) or '= Linear' (bottom panel) in blue bold italic.
visual_elements.position: center column, two stacked gray rounded panels (~30-53% width)

visual_elements.description: Thick red vertical arrow starting below the top-middle panel's y-boxes, pointing down through/past the black 'IF No Non-linearity' callout into the bottom-middle panel toward '= Linear'. A second thick red arrow points down from the 'IF No Bias' callout to the top of the bottom-right panel's 0-column.
visual_elements.position: center column and far right, in the gaps between stacked panels

visual_elements.description: Two black rounded-rectangle callouts with white bold text: 'IF No Non-linearity' (two lines: 'IF No' / 'Non-linearity') between the middle panels, and 'IF No Bias' (one line) between the right panels. They act as conditional annotations: bottom row = same computation without non-linearity / with zero bias.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like). Title: bold, ~28pt, red, title case with emphasized 'FF NN' and 'ONE' (extra spacing around 'FF NN'). Subtitle: bold italic ~16pt blue, with a larger red 'X' and a green italic brace note; subscripts used (W_q). Panel headers and node labels are bold; all weight/matrix labels use subscripted indices (W_11 ... W_44) at ~9-11pt and are color-coded. '= Sigmoid' and '= Linear' are blue bold italic. Callout text is white bold on black. 'Y^T' uses a superscript T. No serif fonts, no all-caps blocks beyond natural capitalization.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all four panels, both black callouts, all arrows, matrices and labels are visible; no mid-build reveal detected. The solid black bar across the bottom edge is almost certainly the video player's progress/control bar overlapping the slide rather than slide content.
recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: create a 16:9 slide with a solid white background (#FFFFFF); draw no slide frame or border (none exists in the source analysis).
2. Title: centered text box spanning ~8-90% width at ~7-14% height with the exact text 'Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of ONE Vector by a Matrix' (preserve the double spaces around 'FF NN'), Arial bold 28pt, red #CC0000.
3. Slide-number badge: circle at ~89-95% width, ~9-16% height (top-right corner), fill #FFFF00, border #CC6600, containing '10' in bold 14pt dark red #990000.
4. Subtitle: centered text box spanning ~8-90% width at ~14-19% height, built as rich-text runs in this order: 'Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word ' (blue #0000CC bold italic 16pt) + 'X' (red #CC0000 bold 20pt) + ' by ' (blue #0000CC bold italic 16pt) + 'W' (blue #0000CC bold italic) with subscript 'q' + ' (Query) ' (blue #0000CC bold italic) + '{Remember: W' (green #009900 bold italic) with subscript 'q' + ' is Squared Matrix}' (green #009900 bold italic).
5. Left panel container: rounded rectangle from ~5% to ~28% width and ~19% to ~95% height, white fill, blue #0000CC border 2pt; header at its top-left: 'Input Word ' (black bold 16pt) + 'X' (red #CC0000 bold 18pt).
6. Left-panel inputs: four circles ~0.9 cm in diameter at x≈8%, y≈27/47/66/85%, fill #FF9CEE, border #CC00CC, labeled x1, x2, x3, x4 (black bold 11pt).
7. Left-panel neurons: four circles at x≈23% on the same four y positions as the inputs, white fill, red #CC0000 border 2pt, each containing 'Σ' (black bold 14pt); at each neuron's upper-left add a ~0.5 cm pie icon with green/blue/red segments, and just below each neuron a gray semi-transparent dotted/halftone circle ~0.9 cm.
8. Left-panel connections: draw all 16 input-to-neuron connections as 0.75pt gray #A0A0A0 straight lines (4 inputs × 4 neurons).
9. Left-panel weight labels: 16 bold 9pt labels with subscripted indices stacked vertically at x≈13-15%, evenly spaced from ~25% to ~88% height in this top-to-bottom order: W_11, W_21, W_31, W_41 (blue #0000CC); W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 (magenta #CC00CC); W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 (orange #FF6600); W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (green #009900).
10. Left-panel outputs: from each neuron a short green #009900 arrow pointing right to a green #009900 bold label y1/y2/y3/y4 placed at x≈26%, vertically aligned with its neuron.
11. Top-middle panel: rounded rectangle ~30-53% width, ~19-54% height, fill #E8E8E8, blue #0000CC border 1.5pt; inside, one horizontal row: 'Y' in red bold 26pt with superscript 'T', then four small boxes (~1.0×0.7 cm, fill #FFFFCC, border #B8860B) labeled y1, y2, y3, y4 (black bold 10pt) with the four-box group wrapped in a pink #FF9CEE rounded-rectangle outline, then '= Sigmoid' in blue #0000CC bold italic 16pt.
12. Bottom-middle panel: identical rounded rectangle at ~30-53% width, ~58-93% height, fill #E8E8E8, blue #0000CC border 1.5pt; same row of red 'Y^T' + pink-outlined group of four yellow boxes y1-y4, ending with '= Linear' in blue #0000CC bold italic 16pt.
13. Callout 'IF No Non-linearity': black #000000 rounded rectangle at ~43-54% width, ~51-60% height, straddling the gap between the two middle panels; white bold 12pt text on two lines: 'IF No' / 'Non-linearity'.
14. Center red arrow: thick red #CC0000 downward arrow starting below the top-middle panel's y-boxes, passing through the step-13 callout, ending inside the bottom-middle panel at '= Linear'.
15. Top-right panel container: rounded rectangle ~54-94% width, ~19-54% height, fill #F0F0F0, blue #0000CC border 1.5pt.
16. Top-right X vector: at the panel's top-left (~55-68% width), a horizontal row of four pink circles (fill #FF9CEE, border #CC00CC) labeled x1, x2, x3, x4, the row wrapped in a pink #FF9CEE rounded-rectangle outline, with 'X' in red #CC0000 bold 20pt centered directly below the row.
17. Top-right W_q matrix: green #CCFFCC background block ~15% wide and ~28% high at ~69-84% width, holding a 4×4 grid of 16 yellow #FFFF66 cells with thin #999999 borders; bold 10pt subscripted cell text — row 1: W_11, W_21, W_31, W_41 (blue #0000CC); row 2: W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 (magenta #CC00CC); row 3: W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 (orange #FF6600); row 4: W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (green #009900).
18. Top-right brace/plus/bias: right of the matrix, a large blue #0000CC right-curly brace '}' at ~85-87% width spanning the matrix height, then a bold '+' (~18pt) at ~87-88% width, then a vertical column of four yellow #FFFF99 rounded boxes with red #CC0000 borders at ~88-94% width, labeled top-to-bottom b1, b2, b3, b4 (black bold).
19. Bottom-right panel: repeat steps 15-18 at ~54-94% width, ~58-93% height, with exactly one change: the four bias-column boxes read 0, 0, 0, 0 (black bold) instead of b1-b4.
20. Callout 'IF No Bias': black #000000 rounded rectangle at ~81-93% width, ~52-59% height, between the two right panels; white bold 12pt text 'IF No Bias' on one line; beneath it a thick red #CC0000 downward arrow pointing to the top of the bottom-right panel's 0-column.

fixes_applied: Schema: verbatim_text.bullets was empty; filled it with the 6 standalone text lines that exist on the slide (subtitle line, 'Input Word X' header, 'Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Sigmoid', 'IF No Non-linearity', 'Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Linear', 'IF No Bias'), all copied verbatim from labels/equations — the slide is a diagram slide with no traditional bullet list.

Consistency: recreation_brief specified #0000FF for the left/middle/right panel borders while visual_elements and colors use #0000CC for all blue elements; changed all three panel border specs to #0000CC.
Consistency: added 6 colors referenced in visual_elements/recreation_brief but missing from colors.accents: #FFFF00, #990000, #A0A0A0, #999999, #B8860B, #F0F0F0.
Consistency: removed the duplicate #CC00CC entry from the network element's colors array (was listed twice).
No-invention: deleted the 'optional thin dark-red rectangle outline' slide frame from recreation_brief step 1 — no frame is described in layout.regions or visual_elements.

Consistency: made the bottom black bar decisive — recreation_brief now instructs to omit it for slide recreation (animation_state identifies it as the video player's progress bar), keeping it only as an option for exact video-frame reproduction.

Consistency: harmonized right-panel geometry — panel rectangles now span ~54-94% width so the curly-brace/plus/bias column (~85-94%) lies inside them; the regions' '~54-87% width (bias column to ~94%)' and the brief's '~54-87%' rectangles contradicted each other.

Precision/recreatability: added missing placements to recreation_brief — x-position for the left-panel y1-y4 output labels (x≈26%, aligned with their neurons) and the vertical span/order of the 16 weight labels (~25-88% height, blue→magenta→orange→green top-to-bottom).

Recreatability: rewrote recreation_brief as a 21-step ordered checklist (callouts now placed before the arrows that pass through them) with exact text, position, color and shape for every element; verified all 11 layout.regions cover every visual_element and all 93 verbatim labels.
uncertain_items: Equation 'Y = W_q · X + b' is inferred from the diagram (X vector × W_q matrix, then + bias column) and is not written as text on the slide; kept in equations with its 'implied' annotation.
Right-panel fill #F0F0F0 appears only in the recreation brief; no region or visual_element states the right-panel fill (middle panels are #E8E8E8), so the exact shade is unverified.

The bottom black strip (~95-100% height) is judged to be the video player's progress bar rather than slide content; if it is actually part of the slide, add a solid black rectangle across the full bottom edge.
Subtitle wording '{Remember: W_q is Squared Matrix}' is consistent across all fields but reads unusually ('Square Matrix' would be expected); verify against the original slide before final build.

Small-text font sizes (9-11pt weight/matrix labels, 10pt box labels, 12pt callouts, 14pt badge text) and the exact positions of the 16 left-panel weight labels and the pie/halftone neuron decorations are estimates from the analysis, not measured values.
